desc:
🥚 Welcome to Catch Rare Eggs!

🤝 PLAY CO-OP! Share a ranch with a friend and build it together!

🥷 Steal eggs and cross the red line before the bosses catch you!
🐣 Hatch eggs and raise pets on your ranch.
💰 Equip pets to earn money every second.
👟 Upgrade your ranch and treadmill. Train to run faster!
🏏 Use your bat to steal other players’ eggs.
🤝 Trade pets and eggs with friends.
🌙 Biomes close at night and new eggs appear.
✨ Discover rare pets, HUGE sizes, and unique mutations!

👀 How far will you go for the rarest egg?
